title: BIGGEST FRANCHISES
subtitle: BOX OFFICE - 2000 to 2026
outro:
Follow for the money
nobody explains.
vo: In the year two thousand, Star Wars and James Bond were Hollywood royalty. Then Harry Potter cast its spell. But nothing prepared the world for the Marvel Cinematic Universe, a franchise that turned comic books into the highest-grossing film series in history. By twenty twenty-six, a handful of franchises dominate the global box office. Which one wins next? Follow, for the money nobody explains.
